_doc: Performance budgets as code — machine-independent latency SLOs. A budget is the maximum allowed ratio of a benchmark's median to the calibration anchor's median (calibration/anchor). Because both are measured on the same host, the ratio cancels machine speed: a budget of 5.0 means 'no slower than 5x this machine's calibration workload', and holds on any runner. `bench-tools budget` fails (exit 1) on any breach. Tighten these as real measurements accumulate; the generous defaults below enforce the mechanism without blocking adoption.
